ridge_selection: validation median gene Pearson, then lower validation MSE, then smaller alpha
mlp_selection: lowest validation MSE among four seed-0 candidates; early stopping on validation MSE
negative_controls: S2-50, NC1 label-row permutation and NC2 embedding-row permutation; primary-selected hyperparameters, separate seed-specific permutation; early stopping on unchanged validation patient
lopo: all four settings; B0, B1 and B2 seeds 0/1/2; fold-training-only feature and target scalers on frozen C0 values; primary-selected hyperparameters; fixed rounded median best epoch across primary B2 seeds
metrics_space: frozen C0 normalized target units, after inversion of additional C1 target scaler
constant_prediction_correlation: undefined (NaN), including B0; do not assign artificial zero correlation
variance_for_gene_maps: training log1p(raw counts) variance; high/median/lowest-positive within each frozen panel
test_access: No primary test cache loaded by fitting stage; evaluation begins only after SELECTION_LOCK.json is written
registry: append-only results/experiment_registry.csv; all fits including candidates are registered
resource_peak: process RSS sampled every 20 ms during fit/inference; includes arrays resident at start; no per-location biological replication claims
